parameters.query: SELECT unsubscribe_token($1) AS r, d_config_json() AS cfg;

filters.q: newer_than:7d -from:me -in:sent (from:mailer-daemon OR from:postmaster OR subject:("Delivery Status Notification" OR Undeliverable OR "Mail delivery failed" OR "Returned mail") OR subject:unsubscribe OR (subject:Dispatch unsubscribe))
